title: Windows artifact forensics
preconditions: Eric Zimmerman tools / regripper / Hindsight available
steps: Identify hives and artifacts: `NTUSER.DAT`, `UsrClass.dat`, SAM/SYSTEM/SOFTWARE, `.pf`, `.evtx`, browser DBs, `$MFT`.
Registry: `RECmd` or `regripper -f NTUSER.DAT -r ntuser`; check Run keys, UserAssist, RecentDocs, USBSTOR, ShellBags.
Execution: `PECmd` for prefetch, `AmcacheParser`/`AppCompatCacheParser` for program execution, `JLECmd`/`LECmd` for jump lists.
Event logs: `EvtxECmd`/`hayabusa` for logons, service installs, PowerShell, and USB; browser: `Hindsight` for history/downloads.
Merge timestamps into a timeline (UTC) and correlate the artifact that answers the challenge question.
falsifier: The image is not Windows, the hives are encrypted/corrupt, or no user artifact exists for the asked event.
